messages:
Maria (CS): quick capture from BigBank onboarding — they've flagged a few product gaps that are hurting enablement and are starting to ask renewal Qs.

Maria (CS): Pain points: 1) No per-route cost breakdown in Console -> finance can't map usage to product lines. 2) SSO audit logs are limited (need user-level logs for compliance). 3) Model pinning behavior confusing during rollouts — they saw a model swap mid-testing. 4) Onboarding docs missing a checklist for Dedicated -> infra team kept blocked for 3 days.

Alex (PM): Thanks — can you rank those by renewal impact? Which one is blocking their go/no-go for production?

Olivia (CSM): +1. BigBank called yesterday; renewal is not a hard 'no' but risk = medium. Top ask is per-route cost and clearer model pinning. They said finance will push back without per-route numbers.

Sam (Engineer): For per-route cost we can add a per-route token breakdown to the billing export and a simple Console widget. Small effort: billing export change = 2 dev-days, Console widget = 3 dev-days. Model pinning: bug was rollout TTL config — we can add explicit version lock in API, that's ~1 dev-day.

Alex (PM): Nice. Can we push per-route billing export change into next sprint as a quick win? Also want to capture feature requests in the product board. @product-bot can you create tickets for: per-route-billing, sso-audit-logs, model-pinning-lock, dedicated-onboarding-checklist?

product-bot: Created tickets: PROD-1423 (per-route billing export), PROD-1424 (SSO audit log retention), PROD-1425 (model pinning / version lock), PROD-1426 (Dedicated onboarding checklist). Links: https://product.redwood/prod/1423 ...1426

Maria (CS): Clients care about prioritization rationale. If we ship per-route billing first, can we offer BigBank a temporary CSV export this week? Even a manual export would buy time.

Sam (Engineer): I can generate an ad-hoc CSV export and hand it to Olivia by EOD today. We'll thread the longer work into sprint planning.

Olivia (CSM): That would help a lot. I'll send to BigBank and ask finance if that satisfies them for the renewal conversation. :thumbsup:

Alex (PM): Assigning priority: per-route-billing = P0 quick win, model-pinning-lock = P1, SSO audit logs = P2 (compliance-heavy), onboarding-checklist = P2. I'll update the roadmap and ping eng-planning.

Maria (CS): Thanks team — I'll update the account health doc and flag renewal risk as 'watch' until we confirm finance is satisfied. Will report back after the call tomorrow.

Olivia (CSM): FYI BigBank also asked for sample prompts/examples for embeddings usage — can Marketing/DevEx help with a short playbook? @Sam (Engineer) can probably sketch it.

Sam (Engineer): Yep, can drop a 1-pager and sample curl snippets in #devex by EOD.

Maria (CS): perfect. Closing loop here — will follow up once BigBank responds. :small_blue_diamond:
